description: This file implements the 'Success' controller for the checkout process in an OpenCart e-commerce application. It handles displaying a confirmation page after a successful order, clearing session data related to the order, and assembling breadcrumbs and messaging based on user login status.

classes.name: Success
classes.description: Controller class handling the display of the checkout success page, clearing session data, and preparing view data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed to render the success page after checkout, managing session cleanup, breadcrumb setup, message display, and loading page components.
